text: EVACUATION ORDER: Eaton Fire. Altadena residents leave now via I-210 (W). Sierra Madre residents leave now and follow directions from emergency personnel. High winds causing rapid fire growth. Prepare to evacuate if you are in Pasadena, San Marino, East Pasadena, San Pasqual, Arcadia, Monrovia, Duarte, La Canada Flintridge, or Bradbury. Stay alert for updates.
